summary: This topic describes how to set up various concession groups (e.g., sibling, staff, third child) in the ERP system. It covers defining concessions by name, applicable fee heads, and concession type (percentage or flat amount).
steps: Navigate to the 'Concession' option (typically under Fee Setup).

To add a new concession group:
Enter the 'Name' of the concession (e.g., Staff Concession, Sibling Concession).
Select the 'Fee Head' to which the concession applies (e.g., Annual Fee, Tuition Fee, or 'All Fee Heads').
If 'Percentage', enter the percentage value (e.g., 50 for 50%).
business_rules: Concessions are session-dependent, meaning they may vary from session to session.
Concessions are applied according to installments, mirroring the fee structure.
important_notes: Concessions can be applied to specific fee heads or all fee heads.
The system supports both percentage-based and flat-amount concessions.
The names of concession groups are user-defined.
